def implementation (numbers: List Rat) (threshold: Rat) : Bool :=
let n := numbers.length;
if n ≤ 1 then

        linarith

        linarith

      if abs diff < threshold then

      else
        loop (i + 1)

import Lean.Data.String

def implementation (string: String) (substring: String) : Nat :=
let n := string.length
let m := substring.length
if m = 0 then
  n
else
  let rec count_from (i: Nat) (occurrences: Nat) : Nat :=
    if i + m > n then
      occurrences
    else
      let sub := string.substr i m
      if sub = substring then
        count_from (i + 1) (occurrences + 1)
      else
        count_from (i + 1) occurrences
  count_from 0 0

let rec find_zero_pair (numbers : List Int) (start : Nat) (end : Nat) : Bool :=
  match start with
  | end => false
  | _ =>
    let i := start
    let j := (start + 1) % numbers.length
    if sum_i_j i j then true
    else find_zero_pair numbers (start + 1) end

def implementation (numbers : List Int) : Bool :=
  numbers.length > 1 →
  find_zero_pair numbers 0 numbers.length
helper_lemmas:
lemma sum_i_j_self : (i : Nat) → numbers[i]! + numbers[i]! = 0 → numbers[i]! = 0
| 0 h => by simp [h]
| i+1 h => by simp [h]

lemma sum_i_j_symmetric : (i j : Nat) → sum_i_j i j ↔ sum_i_j j i
| 0 j => by simp [sum_i_j]
| i+1 j => by simp [sum_i_j]

lemma find_zero_pair_cases : (numbers : List Int) (start end : Nat) →
  find_zero_pair numbers start end ↔
  (∃ i j, start ≤ i < end ∧ start ≤ j < end ∧ i ≠ j ∧ sum_i_j i j)
| numbers 0 end => by simp [find_zero_pair]
| numbers (i+1) end =>
  begin
    have h := find_zero_pair_cases numbers i end,
    by_cases h_sum_i_j : sum_i_j i (i+1) mod numbers.length,
    { simp [h_sum_i_j] },
    { simp [h] }
  end

lemma find_zero_pair_terminates : (numbers : List Int) → find_zero_pair numbers 0 numbers.length = false
| [] => by simp

    have h_sum_i_j' := sum_i_j_self 1 (n' = 0),
    simp [h_sum_i_j, h_sum_i_j', h]
  end

  match lst with
  | [] => second_smallest

    let new_smallest := if x < smallest then x else smallest

    loop tail new_smallest new_second_smallest

impl:
match lst with
| [] => none
| [x] => none
| x :: y :: tail =>
  let x' := x
  let y' := y
  if x' < y' then
    if tail.forall (· ≤ x') then
      some y'
    else
      none
  else
    if tail.forall (· ≤ y') then
      some x'
    else
      none
end

def implementation (lst: List Int) : Option Int :=
match lst with
| [] => none
| [x] => none
| x :: y :: tail =>
  let smaller_els := lst.filter (· < x)
  if smaller_els.length > 0 then
    let second_smallest := smaller_els.drop 0.head
    let smaller_els_filtered := smaller_els.filter (· = smaller_els.get! 0)
    if smaller_els_filtered.length = smaller_els.length then
      some second_smallest
    else
      none
  else
    match y < x with
    | true => some y
    | false => implementation (y :: tail)
  | _ => implementation tail

  | [] => []
  | head :: tail =>

import data.list.basic
import data.nat.basic
import tactic.lint

def implementation (n: Nat) : List Nat :=
  let rec aux (acc: List Nat) (n: Nat) : List Nat :=
    if n = 1 then
      1 :: acc
    else
      let next := if n % 2 = 0 then n / 2 else n * 3 + 1
      if collatz_reachable n next then
        next :: aux (next :: acc) next
      else
        aux acc next
  aux [] n

lemma collatz_reachable_transitive (n m p : Nat) :
  collatz_reachable n m → collatz_reachable m p → collatz_reachable n p :=
begin
  intros h1 h2,
  obtain ⟨k1, hk1⟩ := h1,
  obtain ⟨k2, hk2⟩ := h2,
  use k1 + k2,
  simp [Nat.iterate] at hk2,
  simp [hk1, hk2]
end

lemma collatz_reachable_1 (n: Nat) :
  collatz_reachable n 1 :=
begin
  use 0,
  simp [Nat.iterate]
end

lemma collatz_reachable_odd (n m: Nat) (h: Odd m) (hn: collatz_reachable n m) :
  collatz_reachable n (m / 2) :=
begin
  cases h with h,
  have h' := congr_arg (λ x, x / 2) h,
  rw [h'],
  use 1 + Nat.find h',
  rw [Nat.find_spec] at h',
  simp [Nat.iterate, h, h']
end

lemma collatz_reachable_even (n m: Nat) (h: Even m) (hn: collatz_reachable n m) :
  collatz_reachable n (m * 3 + 1) :=
begin
  cases h with h,
  have h' := congr_arg (λ x, x * 3 + 1) h,
  rw [h'],
  use 1 + Nat.find h',
  rw [Nat.find_spec] at h',
  simp [Nat.iterate, h, h']
end

lemma collatz_reachable_reachable (n m: Nat) (h: collatz_reachable n m) :
  collatz_reachable m n :=
begin
  cases h with k hk,
  use k,
  simp [Nat.iterate]
end

lemma collatz_reachable_sort (n: Nat) :
  result.Sorted (· < ·) :=
begin
  simp [implementation],
  intros a b h,
  simp [Nat.iterate] at h,
  cases h with k hk,
  simp [Nat.iterate] at hk,
  have h' := collatz_reachable_sort (Nat.iterate (fun x => if x % 2 = 0 then x / 2 else x * 3 + 1) k n),
  simp [h', hk]
end

import tactic

def implementation (n: Nat) : List Nat :=
  let rec collatz_odd_seq (n: Nat) (seq: List Nat) : List Nat :=
    if n = 1 then seq else
    if n % 2 = 0 then
      collatz_odd_seq (n / 2) (seq ++ [n])
    else
      collatz_odd_seq (3 * n + 1) (seq ++ [n])
  collatz_odd_seq n []
